universal_transition_rule: Every transition must be a generated continuous-action connector or part of one uninterrupted take. Crossfade, xfade, freeze frame, static hold, static tail and motion reset are forbidden. The connector inherits visible body, object and camera velocity from the previous take, performs one irreversible physical action, and hands visible motion into the next take. Useful subject, environment and camera motion must occupy the full duration and be explicitly staged in 0-30%, 30-70% and 70-100%; completing the event early and holding a pose is rejection. It must also prove: evident physical camera movement, real three-plane depth, internal scene action and clear progression. Missing any condition means reject.
base_animation_prompt: Animate this approved image as a real cinematic shot, never as a living photo. The camera must physically dolly, truck, crane, track or orbit so perspective visibly changes. Maintain real foreground, midground and background with differential motion and coherent occlusion. Stage one clear physical event plus at least two scene elements moving independently from the camera. Build materially different beginning, middle and end states, then finish on a directional exit or cut motivation without a static tail. Preserve approved identity, geography, objects, colors, lighting design and visual style. Do not add unapproved characters, text, logos, watermarks, captions or native audio.
environment_take: Animate the approved environment as a living cinematic world. Use an evident physical dolly, truck, crane, tracking move or orbit with real perspective change. Keep distinct foreground, midground and background layers that move at physically coherent rates and change overlap or occlusion. Give the environment one readable physical event and at least two independently moving elements. Progress from setup to development to a changed final state that motivates the next cut. No flat 2D parallax, digital zoom-only motion, static hold, text, logo, watermark or native audio.
character_take: Animate the approved character shot with identity locked and a complete physical beat. Use evident physical camera translation and three-plane depth, not soft camera drift. The character performs one readable action with a consequence while at least one separate environmental element and one secondary scene element move independently. The start, middle and end must be materially different and finish on a reaction, directional exit or motivated cut. No face morphing, extra limbs, idle breathing-only motion, new characters, text, watermark or native audio.
climax_take: Animate the approved climax as a progressing cinematic event. Use an evident physical tracking, crane, dolly or orbit move with real perspective change across foreground, midground and background. A physical event must escalate while at least two scene elements react independently; light, smoke and particles support the event but cannot replace it. End in a visibly changed state on the musical impact or cut direction, with no reset or static tail. Preserve identity, geography, composition logic, color and style. No new characters, readable text, logo, watermark or native audio.
brand_take: Animate the approved Pemara branding image as a clean premium logo bumper. Use subtle glow, impact pulse, particles and short hold. Keep logo readable and undistorted. No extra text, no watermark, no native audio unless externally mixed.
veo_kling_shot_contract_prompt: Create a cinematic video take from the approved start frame and optional end frame. Subject: {subject}. Action: {action}. Scene: {scene}. Camera: {camera_movement}, {camera_angle}, {lens}, {focus}; the camera physically translates and perspective visibly changes. Depth: distinct foreground, midground and background with differential motion and coherent occlusion. Internal action: one physical event and at least two independently moving scene elements. Motion beats: start {beat_start}; middle {beat_middle}; end {beat_end}; all three states must materially differ. Lighting: {lighting}. Mood: {mood}. Finish on a motivated hard cut, musical impact or directional exit. Preserve approved identity, objects, geography and style. Generate a real moving shot, not a living photo.
veo_kling_first_last_frame_prompt: Interpolate from the approved first frame to the approved last frame as one coherent continuous-action cinematic shot. Inherit the exact visible body, object and camera velocity from the previous take; never start from rest. Perform one irreversible physical action and reach the last frame while still handing visible motion into the next take. Stage useful motion in all three intervals: inherited approach in 0-30%, irreversible development in 30-70%, and moving consequence/handoff in 70-100%. Use evident physical camera translation, visible perspective change, three-plane depth with differential motion, one clear physical event and at least two independently moving elements. Crossfade, freeze frame, static hold, static tail, early event completion followed by a held pose, and motion reset are forbidden.
veo_kling_camera_control_prompt: Camera direction must be physically explicit and visible: {camera_movement}. The viewpoint must translate through the scene so foreground, midground and background change perspective, overlap or scale at coherent rates. Digital zoom, rack focus, pan/tilt, shake or 2D parallax alone do not satisfy the camera or depth requirement. Never reveal camera rigs, operators, UI, watermarks or unrelated objects.
veo_kling_negative_prompt: No slideshow, no living photo, no crossfade, no xfade, no freeze frame, no static hold, no idle breathing-only motion, no digital zoom-only motion, no flat 2D parallax-only effect, no camera drift without perspective change, no light/particles as the only event, no repeated loop, no reset, no static tail, no fake text, no generated logos, no watermark, no camera rig, no camera operator, no random humans, no silhouettes, no intrusive props, no colored triangles, no color bands, no poster text, no deformed objects, no style drift, no unmotivated cut, no native audio unless explicitly requested.
